Happy Birthday!

Sejal

To my favourite plot twist, Sejal. ❤️

Happy birthday, you beautiful human.

Sometimes I think about how funny life is. We started off in school with you not particularly liking me, and somehow, against all odds, the universe decided we weren't done with each other. Look at us now. From barely getting along to becoming each other's people. If that's not the universe having a sense of humour, I don't know what is.

I'm genuinely grateful that life brought you into mine.

I don't think you realise just how much beauty you bring into the lives of people around you. One of the things I admire most about you is how you manage to make yourself and everything around you beautiful, even when things are chaotic. You have this way of making ordinary moments feel like memories worth keeping. And honestly, I think that's a rare kind of magic.

Thank you for being my safe place, my partner in crime, my therapist, my chaos twin, and sometimes all of those things within the same five minutes. Thank you for making me laugh when I couldn't find a reason to smile, for staying even when there was nothing to fix, and for making even the most random moments feel special just because we were experiencing them together.

I hope life gives you more than just the things you ask for. I hope it gives you experiences that leave you speechless, places that make you feel alive, people who appreciate every little part of you, and opportunities that make you realise just how much you're capable of.

Please never limit yourself. Don't make yourself smaller to fit into places you were meant to outgrow. Take chances, make mistakes, explore, be ridiculous, be brave, and experience this world in every way your heart wants to. You deserve a life that feels as beautiful and limitless as the person you are.

And when life inevitably gets messy, when we get older, busier, and end up taking different roads sometimes, I hope you never question whether you have me. You do. Always. No distance, new chapters, or changes in life could make me any less grateful to have you.

I hope you never lose that beautiful ability to find beauty in chaos. But I also hope you get to experience a life where you don't always have to create beauty out of chaos, where things are simply beautiful for you, too.

I'm glad the girl who didn't particularly like me became one of my favourite people. Wouldn't rewrite that plot twist for anything.

Here's to more memories, more questionable decisions, more laughter, more adventures, and a lifetime of stories we probably shouldn't tell anyone.

Happy birthday, Sejal. I love you, idiot. Never forget how loved you are. ❤️

Time went so fast, but you're still the same in my eyes. When we fight, we laugh, we've cried together, or sometimes I've made you upset, and I'm sorry for that, ehe. But remember, I'll always be there for you, Bihari. Love you. Here are some of the worst yet best photos that I love.
